name: bbmodel-unpack-monorepo
description: Monorepo for BBModel tooling: @bbmodel-tools/core (headless bbmodel toolkit), @bbmodel-tools/vsc (VS Code extension) and @bbmodel-tools/mcp (MCP server).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/vsc && npm run build -w packages/mcp
scripts.package:vsc: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run package -w packages/vsc
